scenarios.desc: T3 Code session asks the council a design question
scenarios.input: You are in T3 Code. Ask the council whether we should build or buy a feature flag service. Answer in 5 short bullets describing what you do. Do not run anything.
scenarios.rationale: The skill resolves members with orchestrator_capabilities, starts one delegate_task per member, and runs the Stage 2 Borda count and chairman through council_steps.py. A response naming those is attributable to the skill.

scenarios.desc: A council member is missing from the harness
scenarios.input: orchestrator_capabilities has no GPT-6.2 Astra in this session. Should I use Gemini instead for the council? Answer in 3 short bullets. Do not run anything.
scenarios.rationale: A missing member is reported and recorded, never replaced. A response that refuses the substitute and records the member as unavailable is attributable to the skill.
